title: Kusanagi Nene — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(This is the time they told me to get here...
I wonder what Miku and the others are up to?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Huh? Was that a buzzer?)

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: Happy birthday to you♪ Happy birthday to you♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: Happy birthday, dear Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday to you♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehehe☆
Happy birthday, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: “And now that our star's arrived, let's begin our adventure!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A-Adventure?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: “There's a special treasure that appears in this world only once a year, My Lady.”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: “But that treasure only shows itself to people who are celebrating their birthday.”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: “Tell me, My Lady, do you know anyone whose birthday is today?”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Hehe, so that's what this is. I guess I'm playing a lady.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I do, in fact. Today is my birthday.”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “Oh, is that so? How lucky!”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: “Would you lend us your aid in locating this special treasure?”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Of course. Let's find that treasure together!”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: “According to the map, the treasure appears inside the ruins deep within this town.”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: “Okay! Let's pass through the town... Huh?!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? That's...

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: “This is our town! We won't let any strangers in!”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: “Oh no! How are we to get to the ruins now?!”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: “You know... I've heard that the plushies of this town all love to sing.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Sing?”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: “That's right. Maybe if we sing for them, they'll let us through♪ Would you help us?”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Okay, I will.”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: “You're very talented, My Lady. It seems the plushies enjoyed your performance, too.”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: “Yeah! They even said they'd show us where the treasure is as thanks for such a lovely song!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Hehe, thank you.”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: “Look, everyone! There's something on that door further in!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Huh?”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: “What is this? It looks like a square frame with tiles of different colors...?”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Oh... It's a sliding puzzle. You move the tiles around to make a full picture.”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “I see. Maybe the door will open if we solve this puzzle.”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: “But that sounds really hard. Can you solve it?”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Hmm, I can't say for sure... But I'll give it a try.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I didn't realize it when we arrived, but this is the Wonder Stage. They built this set just for this show.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Ah, these pieces line up. Which means I can bring these over here, and...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “There. How's that?”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: “Wow, the door opened! You did it, My Lady!”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: “Look, there's something there! Could it be the treasure?!”
se_run_women_002_4
se_run_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Is this the treasure you've been looking for?”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: “Yes. This is the special treasure that shows itself only once a year!”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: “We couldn't have found it without you. Would you care to do the honors?”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I'd be happy to. Here goes... One, two...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Is this...a card? Ah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It says “Happy birthday, Nene!”
Is this...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehehe, it's a birthday card from all of us☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: There's a surprise inside, too! Open it up!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
A surprise?
Ah! Something popped out!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We asked Emu to make a pop-up card for us.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me and Luka did the drawing of you! And we all wrote messages, so be sure to read them!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you all so much...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: For this, and the treasure hunt show too... This has been so much fun.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We had a lot of fun, too! I'm so glad we were able to celebrate your birthday, Nene.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But this isn't the end of the festivities, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're having a party with Tsukasa and the others tonight!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's right. I'll be going to a summer festival with some friends before that, though.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe, what a packed schedule. You work hard at practice every day, so I hope you can relax and enjoy yourself today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I will!
A few hours later
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The meetup spot should be right around...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Heeey, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sorry, everyone. Did I keep you waiting?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Not at all! Airi and I just got here a tiny bit ago!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, that's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've been looking forward to today for so long. Let's all have plenty of fun together.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I never thought I'd be spending my birthday with so many people.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks for reaching out to everyone, Emu. And looking up everything about the festival, too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe! I was just doing my duty as the leader of the Nene Birthday Squad!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yet another new squad...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, because you, and Honami and everyone else, are all here to celebrate Nene's birthday☆

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That we are! We'll celebrate with everything we've got, Captain!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hanasato...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Now that our special guest has arrived... Let's go to the festival☆
